title: Diagnostic Service Component
source_docs: AUTOSAR Blockset/Classic Platform/Basic Software/Diagnostic Event Manager (Dem)/Diagnostic_Service_Component.md
text: Configure AUTOSAR Diagnostic Services and Runtime Environment (RTE) for emulation, {Mask} sets Inhibition condition mask LAST_FAILED; {ID (RTE tab)} sets the iD that identifies service event, operation cycle, or function with inhibition, {Increment step size} sets the fixed-step value to increment event ID counter when PREFAIL events, {Decrement step size} sets the fixed-step value to decrement the event ID counter when PREPASS events, {Failed threshold} sets the dem event ID counter threshold that represents a failed, {Passed threshold} sets the dem event ID counter threshold that represents passed and {ID (FiM tab)} sets the inhibition condition ID. Values come from the instance.

params.name: ID (RTE tab)
params.values: ID that identifies service event, operation cycle, or function with inhibition condition 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Increment step size
params.values: Fixed-step value to increment event ID counter when PREFAIL events arrive 1 (default) | scalar (1 to 32767)

params.name: Decrement step size
params.values: Fixed-step value to decrement the event ID counter when PREPASS events arrive 1 (default) | scalar (1 to 32767)

params.name: Failed threshold
params.values: Dem event ID counter threshold that represents a failed status 2 (default) | scalar (1 to 32767)

params.name: Passed threshold
params.values: Dem event ID counter threshold that represents passed status -1 (default) | scalar (-32768 to -1)

params.name: Mask
params.values: Inhibition condition mask LAST_FAILED | NOT_TESTED | TESTED | TESTED_AND_FAILED
